social_activities: Running and successfully completed various social welfare works and programs through Gurunath Foundation, as Secretary, 2011-2013 and now working as the Chairperson of the Foundation, successfully carried out Pre-Competitive Exam Coaching and Preparation Classes for the needy and poor students of the district; arranged a Health Camp in 2012, where total 4500 patients were examined and given spectacles and 557 patients were sent to Mumbai for major operations with the help of the Foundation; arranged Pre-Police Recruitment Training Camp in Muktainagar in 2013; health care camp; eye care and checking camp; successfully running poor and needy girl’s hostel at Jalgaon; arranged a Camp on ‘Female Feticide’ for women; arranged women awareness programmes on ‘Women and Law’ and ‘Women and their changing status in Present Time’
interests: Social work, reading, sports and visiting natural spots
